mapper.select: SELECT student_id AS studentId, course_id AS courseId, chapter_id AS chapterId, section_id AS sectionId, content_viewed AS contentViewed, practice_completed AS practiceCompleted, resource_reviewed AS resourceReviewed, completed, mastery_state AS masteryState, last_position AS lastPosition, recommended_next_action AS recommendedNextAction, last_event_time AS lastEventTime, weak_knowledge_points AS weakKnowledgePointsJson FROM student_section_progress WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND chapter_id = #{chapterId} AND section_id = #{sectionId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_section_progress ( student_id, course_id, chapter_id, section_id, content_viewed, practice_completed, resource_reviewed, completed, mastery_state, last_position, recommended_next_action, last_event_time, weak_knowledge_points, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{progress.studentId}, #{progress.courseId}, #{progress.chapterId}, #{progress.sectionId}, #{progress.contentViewed}, #{progress.practiceCompleted}, #{progress.resourceReviewed}, #{progress.completed}, #{progress.masteryState}, #{progress.lastPosition}, #{progress.recommendedNextAction}, #{progress.lastEventTime}, #{weakKnowledgePointsJson}, UNIX_TIMESTAMP() * 1000, UNIX_TIMESTAMP() * 1000 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE content_viewed = VALUES(content_viewed), practice_completed = VALUES(practice_completed), resource_reviewed = VALUES(resource_reviewed), completed = VALUES(completed), mastery_state = VALUES(mastery_state), last_position = VALUES(last_position), recommended_next_action = VALUES(recommended_next_action), last_event_time = VALUES(last_event_time), weak_knowledge_points = VALUES(weak_knowledge_points), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
